text.name: Sun Shield
text.description:
{Sun Shield}

This left handed item increases your Defense skill by +5, and decreases opponent's Spell Power by 2.
text.event: During a journey, you encounter Wadjets sleeping nearby, with a source of incredible radiance in their nest. You quietly sneak up and take the object. In safety, you marvel at the glistening beauty of the Sun Shield.

text.name: Frog Of Sagacity
text.description:
{Frog Of Sagacity}

The Frog of Sagacity allows you to cast spells with effectiveness increased by 1 level of magic school mastery.
text.event: When approaching a turn, you spot a nomad dying from thirst and exhaustion. In exchange for a generous draught from your flask, he gives you a wrapped bundle. You open it and take out a peculiar statue, but you notice the stranger had disappeared in the meantime.
